title: Mr Fox 🦊
tagline: Mr Fox 🦊 is the last web3 assistant you will ever need. Swap, bridge, track any token just by talking... and completely non-custodially!
description:
✅  **Ease of use** -*With Mr fox, doing anything in web3 is as simple as talking!* 

Most newcomers to web3 do not know what to do; 
They dont know which exchange to trust, which dapp to use.
With Mr fox, we take care of integrating protocols so that you can just tell him what you want to do, and Mr fox will decide which protocol to interact with. 

✅ **Security**  - Using *1Inch's Fusion SDK*, Mr Fox ensures that you can swap without the fear of being front-run with fusion SDK

✅  **Private** - The biggest concern with AI is privacy. By using *waku protocol*, we ensure that the end-user's identity stays completely anonymous

✅  **Integrable and composable** - Any protocol can be integrated into Mr fox. Instead of building a complete dapp, Mr Fox can help onboard users onto a protocol by providing a ready-made interface.

how_its_made:
The biggest challenge was to decouple the fusion sdk into front-end and backend parts. We had to break the implementation down into functions. Some functions required wallet interactions, so they had to be called from front-end. And others had to be called from backend - since they required API key.
Besides that, it was a challenge to deploy the app because waku nodes take very long to initialise sometimes. As of now, its not live, but we are working on it 😃
